_devNote: Admin/dev-only import file. Add imported licks to the licks array; the app renders only this imported JSON data. Do not add a lick unless the source has clear reuse permission for every imported asset. If tabSourceAllowed is false, leave tab empty and provide audioUrl plus license/source details.

_format.title: string
_format.tab: string, optional; include only when tabSourceAllowed is true
_format.tabSourceAllowed: boolean; true only when tablature reuse is clearly permitted

_importRules: Only import licks from sources with clear reuse permission.
Keep sourceUrl, license, attribution, and licenseNotes populated for every lick.
Set tabSourceAllowed to true only when tablature reuse is explicitly allowed.
When tabSourceAllowed is false, do not include tab content; the app will show audio only with a licensing note.
